sender.en: “An Garda Síochána” (the Garda crest as profile photo)

name.en: Fake Garda calling on WhatsApp for your bank details

how.en: You get a WhatsApp call or message from someone whose profile photo is the Garda crest. They say they are a Garda and ask for personal information such as your bank account details. Gardaí will never contact you out of the blue by phone and ask for your bank details.

text.en: A WhatsApp call or message comes from a profile with the Garda crest.
They say it is urgent, for example about an investigation.
They ask for your bank account or personal details.
This is Garda Sergeant Byrne. Your name has come up in a fraud investigation and we need to check your account is not involved. Reply today with your bank, IBAN and date of birth so we can clear you.

en: whatsapp call with garda crest profile picture
gardai asked for my bank details
guard rang asking for my iban
garda investigation message asking for personal details
garda said my bank account is linked to a fraud case
The Garda crest on a WhatsApp profile.
A “Garda” asking for your bank details: Gardaí never do this out of the blue.
A call from an unknown number.
Hang up or don’t reply. Don’t answer calls from unknown numbers.
If you are unsure, ring your local Garda station yourself.
If you shared bank details, call your bank and report it at your local Garda station.
